_comment: Regression eval gold-set for /agent-team:eval. Each case runs through the gated pipeline against its target, then its `check` shell command scores it. `target` below is the DEFAULT; a case may override it, and `requires` names the directory the case cannot run without. Resolve the plan with `python3 evals/resolve_cases.py` — it decides RUN vs SKIP deterministically, so a missing directory is a stated skip rather than a silent failure. Add cases here as the team's prompts/roster/templates evolve.
_targets: demo-app is an OPTIONAL sample: it can be deleted once you have your own repo. Cases bound to it therefore declare `requires: demo-app` and SKIP when it is gone. A skip is not a pass — the scorecard prints it as `- skipped` and says why. To add cases for your own repo, copy a case, set its `target` + `requires` to your project directory, and write a `check` that fails before the work and passes after.

cases.prompt: Add a truncate(text, length, suffix='...') helper to textkit: create textkit/truncate.py shortening text to at most `length` chars total (append suffix only when it cuts, never exceed length; return unchanged when it already fits). Export truncate from textkit/__init__.py. Add tests/test_truncate.py.
cases.check: python3 -c "from textkit import truncate; assert truncate('hello world', 8) == 'hello...'; assert truncate('hi', 8) == 'hi'; assert len(truncate('abcdefghij', 5)) <= 5" && python3 -m pytest -q

cases.prompt: Make sure slugify handles empty/whitespace input: slugify('') and slugify('   ') both return ''. Add tests covering it if missing.
cases.check: python3 -c "from textkit import slugify; assert slugify('') == ''; assert slugify('   ') == ''; assert slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'" && python3 -m pytest -q
